description_en: Modifies the automatic backup cycle, backup time window, and level-1 backup retention period of a specified application
description_zh: 修改指定应用的自动备份周期、备份时间段和一级备份保留时长
name: ModifyApplicationBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用所在地域的地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The application type, such as polarclaw
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: The days of the week when automatic backups are performed. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday
parameters.help_zh: 自动备份执行的星期。多个值使用英文逗号分隔，取值为 Monday（周一）、Tuesday（周二）、Wednesday（周三）、Thursday（周四）、Friday（周五）、Saturday（周六）、Sunday（周日）
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en: The time window when automatic backups are performed. The format is HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ in UTC. The start time and end time must be on the hour and exactly one hour apart
parameters.help_zh: 自动备份执行的时间段，格式为 HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ，使用 UTC 时间。开始与结束时间必须为相隔一小时的整点
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en: The retention period of level-1 backups, in days
parameters.help_zh: 一级备份的保留时长，单位为天
parameters.name: preferred_backup_retention_period
